BiblicalUsage: gᵉnêbâh means thing stolen, theft. It turns up twice, in Exodus.
TheologicalSignificance: I take gᵉnêbâh as it stands — thing stolen, theft — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
